response.sql: WITH filtered_trans AS (SELECT t.account_id, t.type, t.amount, t.balance, d.A3 as region FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id), account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, region, AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount END) as avg_amount, AVG(balance) as avg_balance FROM filtered_trans GROUP BY account_id, region), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) as region_avg_amount, AVG(avg_balance) as region_avg_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), global_stats AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as global_avg_amount FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg_amount, r.region_avg_balance, r.region_avg_amount / g.global_avg_amount FROM region_averages r CROSS JOIN global_stats g WHERE g.global_avg_amount IS NOT NULL
